title: Valor 0.1 is here
body: Custom menus for every screen, the Silk wallpaper, your own picture, GIF or video wallpapers, and 19 mods to start with.

title: The mods menu
body: Press Right Shift in game to turn mods on and off, change their settings, and move your HUD in the layout editor.

title: More mods on the way
body: Crosshair, hit colour, 1.7 animations, block overlay, freelook and more are next.
